info.title: Files Connect API
info.description: API for file uploads, downloads, and processing

get.description: Checks if the API is running properly

post.summary: List files in a databank directory
post.description: Returns a list of files and directories in the specified databank directory

recursive.description: When true, returns all files recursively including those in subdirectories

post.summary: Download a specific file from a databank
post.description: Returns a specific file or generates a presigned URL for download

presigned.description: Whether to return a presigned URL

post.summary: Get metadata for a specific file in a databank
post.description: Returns metadata for a specific file in a databank

post.summary: Delete a specific file from a databank
post.description: Deletes a specific file from a databank by key

post.summary: Generate preview for a specific file in a databank
post.description: Returns a preview of a specific file in a databank

maxLines.description: Maximum number of lines to return

400.description: Invalid request or file format not supported

post.summary: Initiate a multipart upload to a databank
post.description: Initiates a multipart upload to a databank and returns presigned URLs for uploading parts. Only allows CSV, JSON, TXT, Parquet, XLSX, and ZIP file types. Executable files are not permitted.

put.summary: Complete a multipart upload to a databank
put.description: Finalizes a multipart upload to a databank

post.description: Cancels an in-progress multipart upload and removes any uploaded parts
Uploads an asset using multipart/form-data and returns a unique key for future reference. Only PDF and image files are allowed (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, SVG, TIFF, BMP).

key.description: Unique key for the uploaded asset

post.summary: Get a presigned URL for an asset
post.description: Returns a presigned URL for downloading an asset

get.description: Returns a presigned URL for downloading the databank zip file

post.summary: Create a processing job for a databank
post.description: Creates a new processing job (zip and/or report) for a databank

type.description: Type of processing job (zip or report)

put.description: Updates the status of a processing job for a databank
